Magnus Carlsen decided to make his life interesting by not turning up to the two rapid games against Vladislav Artemiev at the Total World Championship 2026 Pilot in Budapest. He was then in a must-win scenario in the fast classic portion. And mind you, Magnus has not won a single game in the fast classic format. Check out the game along with commentary by IM Sagar Shah.
